messages.content: Please check out our concept for on Messaging App. We have revamped the design of this application in a whole new way. After analyzing the pain points of an end-user and talking with some non-tech guys we understand that we need some changes in our daily application uses which saves the user's time. So first of all we have categorized all the messages, and as users facing problems on multiple selections So we have shifted options to the bottom for easy access. After that we have added unread messages to the top of the inner chat screen so that users don't need to go back every time for every single message
